verdicts.criterion: design >= literature 3.0-4.5 m (9-16 m depth, Neelamani) and data EVA
verdicts.detail: only 4 years of data -> data EVA is indicative; literature governs

C6b low tide screen velocity at max 172.5 m3/s
verdicts.detail: relief: add bays/lengthen line for low-water max-flow, or accept higher approach at LAT

verdicts.test: C7 duplex 2205/2507 mesh & crevices at SST 36-38 C
verdicts.criterion: NORSOK M-001 Rev.5: 25Cr duplex <= 20 C in seawater with crevices (via TWI)
verdicts.detail: woven-mesh knuckles and rail contacts are crevices; immersion is in the hottest months. Use titanium Gr2, Cu-Ni 90/10, or polymer (HDPE/PET/UHMWPE) mesh; keep duplex only above water

verdicts.test: C8 electrical/drive equipment vs air temperature (ERA5 grid max; land sites hotter)
verdicts.criterion: standard IEC motor/VFD/PLC rating 40 C ambient
verdicts.detail: derate motors (~0.9 at 50 C), shaded/air-conditioned panels, solar-load on drums & load cells (temperature-compensated range)

verdicts.test: C9 HDPE seabed pipe at 36-38 C
verdicts.criterion: pipe is low-pressure (~7 m head) -> derated rating still >> duty
verdicts.detail: check ring stiffness/creep for ballast loads at temperature

verdicts.criterion: drums, bearings, brakes, load cells sealed IP66; rolled mesh under a shroud; camera/lens wash
verdicts.detail: the plant already designs penetrations > 6 m above grade for dust (ENEC 2012). Abrasion of rolled mesh by trapped sand on every roll-down -> brush/spray on lowering too

verdicts.test: C11 envelope policy: storm stow vs bloom
verdicts.value: stow wind gust > 20.0 m/s only for motion; stay deployed up to Hs 4.0 m
verdicts.criterion: screen must not be forced up in a shamal (onshore drift drives blooms)
verdicts.detail: design rule: roll-down/up blocked above 20 m/s gust but a deployed bay may stay down; hard-limit relief still active. Needs deployed-storm load case in detailed design
